Metrics of Assessment Target detection and classiﬁcation are major challenges in most practical computer vision applications. Hence the necessity to use metrics that allow to validate the capacity that the system has in the detection of objects through signiﬁcant dimensions. There are two important and distinct tasks to measure in object detection, these are: (a) to determine if an object is present and (b) where it is located within the image. Target recognition metrics provide a measure for evaluating the performance of the model in an object detection task. Some performance metrics are Precision, Accuracy and Recall.
